en.title: Notion export formats: HTML or Markdown & CSV?
en.description: Choose a Notion export format for Obsidian or Joplin and check subpages, links, and attachments in the ZIP before importing.
en.intro: Choose the format for your import workflow, then inspect the ZIP for child pages, links, and attachments.
choices: Use Obsidian Importer’s Notion → File import
Choose HTML and keep the ZIP Notion produces.
Choose Markdown & CSV, extract the ZIP, and select the folder containing the notes and attachments.
Keep notes you can open in a plain-text editor
Choose Markdown & CSV and check the ZIP for .md files and the attachments you need.
en.layoutTitle: How do subpage folders change the ZIP?
en.sample: We inspected three exports of the same Notion sample with a parent page, two cross-linked child pages, a PNG, and a TXT file.
layouts: The parent .html is at the root. A and B share a subfolder, and the attachments are in a folder for A.
The parent .md is at the root. A and B share a subfolder, and the attachments are in a folder for A.
All three .md files, the PNG, and the TXT are at the root.
en.evidence: The PNG and TXT each had the same SHA-256 hash across all three ZIPs. Both Markdown & CSV exports contained three .md files. This sample produced no .csv files.
checklist: Extract the ZIP into a separate folder. Keep the original ZIP and preserve the extracted folder structure.
Locate the parent page and both child pages. Open HTML in a browser or inspect Markdown in a text editor.
Check the links from the parent to A and B and in both directions between A and B. Verify that each target exists in the extracted folder.
Open the PNG and TXT to check the image and text. After importing, open them again from the note to see how the destination app handles them.
en.missingLink: The first HTML export lacked the return link from B to A. A fresh export of the sample contained both the link and its target file. If a link is missing, check the original Notion page, then export again and inspect the ZIP.

zh-Hant.title: Notion 匯出選 HTML 還是 Markdown & CSV？
zh-Hant.description: 比較 Notion 的 HTML 與 Markdown & CSV 匯出，選擇適合 Obsidian 或 Joplin 的格式，並在匯入前檢查子頁、連結和附件。
zh-Hant.intro: 準備把 Notion 筆記搬到 Obsidian 或 Joplin 時，可以先依照要使用的匯入方式選擇格式，再打開 ZIP 確認子頁、連結和附件。
choices: 在 Obsidian 使用 Importer 的 Notion → File import
選 HTML，保留 Notion 產出的 ZIP。
選 Markdown & CSV，解壓縮後選取包含筆記和附件的資料夾。
保留可用純文字編輯器開啟的筆記
選 Markdown & CSV，確認 ZIP 內有 .md 檔與所需附件。
zh-Hant.layoutTitle: 子頁資料夾會怎麼影響 ZIP？
zh-Hant.sample: 我們檢查了同一個 Notion 測試頁的三份匯出。樣本有一個父頁、兩個互相連結的子頁、一張 PNG 和一份 TXT。
layouts: 父頁 .html 在根目錄，A 和 B 在子資料夾，附件在 A 對應的資料夾。
父頁 .md 在根目錄，A 和 B 在子資料夾，附件在 A 對應的資料夾。
先前的 Markdown & CSV 匯出
三篇 .md、PNG 和 TXT 都在根目錄。
zh-Hant.evidence: 三份 ZIP 的 PNG 和 TXT 各自具有相同的 SHA-256。兩份 Markdown & CSV 匯出都包含三個 .md，樣本中沒有 .csv。
checklist: 把 ZIP 解壓到獨立資料夾，保留原始 ZIP 與解壓後的目錄結構。
找到父頁和兩個子頁。用瀏覽器開啟 HTML，或用文字編輯器查看 Markdown。
核對父頁通往 A、B 的連結，以及 A、B 互相往返的連結。確認各連結的目標檔案都存在。
開啟 PNG 和 TXT，確認圖片可讀、文字正確。匯入後再從筆記內開一次，確認目標 App 如何處理附件。
zh-Hant.missingLink: 第一次 HTML 匯出就缺少 B 回到 A 的連結。同一個樣本重新匯出後，該連結和目標檔案都在 ZIP 裡。若你也遇到連結缺失，可以先回原頁確認連結，再重新匯出並檢查 ZIP。
